title: iPhone chat: no test counts requests at the transport after a failed record read; ChatView's send is private and builds ChatClient inline. A seam (send's context-then-ask body as a plain @MainActor function taking a ChatClient) would let a test assert zero requests at StubHTTP. Chat thread's file.
evidence: Owner of ChatView.swift: the chat thread. ios/HealthRoadmap/Chat/ChatView.swift send (:228-262) builds the context from store.recordJSON (:239), then ChatClient().ask with AppAttestClient.shared, whose URLSession is private and fixed at init, so no stub reaches it. ChatClient already has var attest, and AppAttestClient(session:) takes StubHTTP.session(). Today UnreadableRecordTests.testTheChatHasNoContextToSendAfterAFailedRead_US25_AC11p pins only the context's throw and the failure words (US-25 AC11p). Found in PR 1408 (lead S27)
